decision.commentPlaceholder: Add a note for the requester…

approve.title: Approve request
approve.description: The request moves to the next approval step, or is approved if this is the last one.

reject.title: Reject request
reject.description: The request is closed and the employee is notified with your reason.
reject.commentPlaceholder: Explain why the request is rejected…

return.title: Return for information
return.description: The requester can edit the request and resubmit it; it will come back to this step.
return.commentPlaceholder: Describe the information or documents required…
return.hint: Any leave hold is released until the request is resubmitted.

reassign.title: Reassign request
reassign.description: Hand the request over to another person. They are notified immediately.

start.title: Start working on this request
start.description: The request is marked in progress and assigned to you if it has no owner yet.

complete.title: Complete request
complete.description: The request is closed as completed and the employee is notified.

cancel.title: Cancel request
cancel.description: The request stops here. Any leave hold or deduction is reversed.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Available to you at this stage.
actions.submitConfirmDescription: The request is sent to the first approver and can no longer be edited unless it is returned.

none.completed: This request is completed. No further actions are needed.
none.rejected: This request was rejected and is closed.
none.cancelled: This request was cancelled and is closed.
none.pending: Waiting for the current approver. You'll be notified of any update.
none.approved: Approved — HR is fulfilling the request.
none.returned: Waiting for the requester to update and resubmit.
none.generic: No actions are available to you right now.

timeline.title: Activity
timeline.description: Every action on this request, newest first.
